meta.source: Medioo UX deep dive 2026-10-17, evolved from DR-14 tokens in baymax.css

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background (warm paper / deep ink). Evolves --c-bg.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, bot chat bubbles, sheets at rest. Evolves --c-surface.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Quiet blocks, quiet buttons, neutral chips; dark-mode elevated level 1. Evolves --c-surface-2.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Pressed state of quiet surfaces; dark-mode sheets/dialogs (elevated). New.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons (on-surface). 12.9:1 on bg light, 15.1:1 dark. Evolves --c-text.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, meta, timestamps (on-surface-variant). Darkened from #566663 so it clears 5.6:1 on surface-2. Evolves --c-muted.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and card hairlines only (1.27:1, not a control boundary). Evolves --c-line.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Boundaries of interactive controls: text fields, checkboxes, outlined buttons (>=3:1, WCAG 1.4.11). New; replaces --c-line on inputs.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Filled primary buttons, active tab, links on emphasis, focus-adjacent accents. Teal from the Mio asset. Evolves --c-accent.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text/icons on primary (5.17:1 light, 6.88:1 dark). Evolves --c-on-accent.

tokens.name: primary-pressed
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed primary. Replaces today's hover-to-ink, which made a hovered primary button look like the dark destructive button. New.

tokens.name: primary-container
tokens.usage: Tonal buttons, selected chips, active tab indicator pill, Mio avatar ground. Evolves --c-accent-soft.

tokens.name: on-primary-container
tokens.usage: Text on primary-container. Use this, not primary, for small text on the tint (primary on tint is 4.42:1 and fails AA).

tokens.name: bubble-me
tokens.usage: The family's own chat bubble (right side). Evolves --c-me.

tokens.name: brand-green
tokens.usage: Wordmark 'oo' and illustration accents only. Never text, never status. Evolves --c-brand-2.

tokens.name: brand-dot
tokens.usage: Wordmark dot only; the one non-urgency red, sanctioned by DR-14 amendment.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 3px focus ring, 2px offset, on every focusable element. Evolves --c-focus.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: status-inside
tokens.usage: Value verdict INSIDE only (value, ref_low and ref_high all parse and the value lies inside). Check-in-circle icon + 'সীমার মধ্যে'. Never on a document, never for a one-sided or missing range, never green, never 'all fine'.

tokens.name: status-inside-container
tokens.usage: Chip ground for the INSIDE value chip only. Not used for ROUTINE documents (they have no chip).

tokens.name: status-soon
tokens.usage: THIS_WEEK document urgency (calendar icon + urgency.this_week verbatim) AND value rows whose per-value verdict is OUTSIDE (▲/▼ icon + 'সীমার বেশি'/'সীমার কম'), so a row and the banner it feeds share one colour.

tokens.name: status-soon-container
tokens.usage: THIS_WEEK banner/chip ground and the OUTSIDE value-row tint.

tokens.name: status-now
tokens.usage: RESERVED. NOW-level urgency on any surface, CRITICAL value rows, emergency card: octagon-exclamation icon + urgency.now / emergency template verbatim.

tokens.name: status-now-container
tokens.usage: RESERVED. NOW banner ground. Evolves --c-urgent-soft.

tokens.name: status-now-solid
tokens.usage: RESERVED. Filled NOW chip/banner header, with on-status-now text (6.47:1 light, 5.62:1 dark).

tokens.name: on-status-now
tokens.usage: Text on status-now-solid.

tokens.name: status-unknown
tokens.usage: Value verdict UNKNOWN: value or range does not parse ('> 89', '130 / 80', 'Positive'), one-sided or missing range, partial read, processing. Dashed-circle icon + 'কাগজে মিলিয়ে দেখুন' or 'রিপোর্টে সীমা লেখা নেই'. No bar. Never implies normal.

tokens.name: status-unknown-container
tokens.usage: Ground for UNKNOWN value chips, review-state chips and the retake card.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive buttons (delete family, remove document): dark ink, never red. Always behind a confirm step. Evolves --c-danger.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on danger.

tokens.name: warn-container
tokens.usage: Non-urgency notices (retake requested, offline, OTP problems). Not an urgency colour. Evolves --c-warn-soft.

tokens.name: warn-line
tokens.usage: Border of warn notices. Evolves --c-warn-line.

tokens.name: sp-0
tokens.usage: Hairline nudges, chip icon gap. New.

tokens.name: sp-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label inside chips. Kept.

tokens.name: sp-2
tokens.usage: Minimum gap between adjacent touch targets (Android guidance 8dp). Kept.

tokens.name: sp-3
tokens.usage: Padding around bezeled controls (HIG ~12pt); bubble gap. Kept.

tokens.name: sp-4
tokens.usage: Page side gutter, card padding. Kept.

tokens.name: sp-5
tokens.usage: Padding around unbezeled controls (HIG ~24pt); section gap inside a screen. Kept.

tokens.name: sp-6
tokens.usage: Between screen sections. Kept.

tokens.name: sp-7
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target edge (Material 48dp); footer top margin. Kept.

tokens.name: sp-8
tokens.usage: Landing section rhythm. Kept.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height/width of every tappable control (satisfies HIG 44pt and Material 48dp). New.

tokens.name: tabbar-h
tokens.usage: Bottom tab bar height, plus env(safe-area-inset-bottom). New.

tokens.name: composer-h
tokens.usage: Chat composer minimum height, grows to 5 lines. New.

tokens.name: w-app
tokens.usage: App column max width. Kept.

tokens.name: w-page
tokens.usage: Marketing/landing max width. Kept.

tokens.name: chip-pad-y
tokens.usage: Minimum vertical padding of single-line chips (allows 1.4 line-height for Bangla).

tokens.name: now-strip-h
tokens.usage: Collapsed NOW strip once the chat thread scrolls; still undismissable, still red, still names the patient.

tokens.name: r-xs
tokens.usage: Value crops, small thumbnails, range bar ends. New (Material extra-small ~4dp).

tokens.name: r-s
tokens.usage: Inputs' inner elements, document thumbnails, focus ring. Kept.

tokens.name: r-m
tokens.usage: Cards, banners, chat bubbles. Kept (Material large 16dp).

tokens.name: r-l
tokens.usage: Large cards, empty-state panels. Kept.

tokens.name: r-xl
tokens.usage: Bottom sheet top corners, dialogs (Material extra-large 28dp). New.

tokens.name: r-tail
tokens.usage: The tail corner of a chat bubble. New (was a literal 4px in baymax.css).

tokens.name: r-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, tab indicator, language toggle. Kept.

tokens.name: shadow-0
tokens.usage: Flat content on bg.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Cards, bot bubbles. Light = today's --shadow; dark = tonal surface + hairline (HIG base vs elevated), shadows are invisible on dark.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Sticky composer and bottom tab bar (shadow points up).

tokens.name: shadow-3
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets, dialogs (on surface / surface-3 in dark).

tokens.name: shadow-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts and snackbars.
